notes.title: Demo Patch v2.1
notes.content:
I'm aware some of these encore battles are frustrating to play with a gamepad / keyboard. I'm working on a second playable character that works better with those input methods. But I will still be improving gamepad controls in general.

[list]
[*]Changed victory screen a bit when beating encore from a normal fight.
[*]Changed Diver EX to be a bit cleaner.
[*]Driller EX is fixed when fighting it from the base battle.
[*]Encores now have reduced health.
[/list]

notes.title: Chromahertz Demo Version 2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I've been hard at work on some demo improvements. The content is looking finished for this demo, so I will focus on bug fixes and accessibility from here.

[list]
[*]Encore battles have been revamped to be more unique and challenging.
[*]Encore battles are now optional after getting to them once. Just strike the medal as it flutters by.
[*]Encore battles have their own leaderboards if you want to challenge them separately.
[*]New finesse medal for encore battles. You can't get these unless your efficiency is perfect. So, don't warp unless you ABSOLUTELY have to. And all bullet reflection must be done with an empty gauge. Risky!
[*]There is a sound and visual effect when you miss the finesse medal, but a more obvious effect is in the works.
[*]New perfect medal for getting every medal in one go. Good luck getting this one...
[*]Your personal stats shown on the level select screen are now all your medals and lowest times, regardless of when you got them.
[*]There are now difficulty ratings for the levels. I hope this will clear up some concerns about how hard I plan to make future content.
[*]FIXED menu screen being shifted around in some cases.
[/list]

Please check out the Kickstarter! There are only 7 days left and it's at 36%. I could really use your help!!!

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.9
notes.content:
New "Always Move" option for mouse controls! I understand the control rebinding is looking intimidating right now and some combinations don't work... especially because there's no guide for it currently. It needs a revamp with some in game explanations, but bear with me...

[h3]Always Move[/h3]
[list]
[*]Left clicking once in game will make the player always move to the cursor while this option is on.
[*]Changes the mouse controls so that you always draw with left click.
[*]Right click to warp functions normally... To make it easier on your hands you can enable the "Warp Toggle" option so that you only have to right click once to start/stop focusing.
[/list]
Later there will be an option to simply hold and release to warp. There will also be a new preset for simplified mouse controls as well as an updated tutorial for it. [b]This will probably become the default.[/b] But I need to think about it a little more.

To test this preset, select "[b]Mouse Only[/b]" in the rebind menu -> [b]Copy Preset[/b] -> Scroll down and enable "[b]Warp Toggle[/b]" and "[b]ALWAYS Move[/b]" 

Right now I'm short on time because I have to prepare the Steam Next Fest stream. As always thank you for the feedback and please help this game get funded on [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/slugsoft/chromahertz/]Kickstarter[/url][/b]! It's at 28% funded right now.

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Thanks for giving the demo a try. I've been noting your bug reports and suggestions. If you're having a good time, [b]please share it and back the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/slugsoft/chromahertz/]Kickstarter[/url][/b]. It's already at 25% after one day! 

Here are some changes:

[list]
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] gamepad controls in Towers' tornado being too slow.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] effect with mouse-draw-instead-of-move being [i]misleading[/i]...
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] Leaderboard display issues.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] viewscreen menu not working on gamepad.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b] gamepad shoulder and trigger icons being reversed.
[*] [b]ADDED[/b] a highlight to your current leaderboard rank, and a button to go there.
[*] [b]ADDED[/b] a speed modifier bind for keyboard and gamepad users. It works with analog input and boosts your speed up to 50% faster. But I will add a slider for this so you can customize it later. [b]If you already have custom binds it will be blank. By default it's the right trigger and the W key.[/b]
[/list]

I'm still working on improving the gamepad support and leaderboard features. There are a few minor graphical issues to fix as well but, I will get to them much later. Thanks for reading!
